why.en: With he or she (my sister) the present simple verb takes -s: works.
why.uz: Present Simple zamonida he yoki she (my sister) bilan feʼlga -s qoʻshiladi: works.
why.ru: В Present Simple с he или she (my sister) глагол получает -s: works.

stem.en: Look! The children ___ in the park.

why.en: Look! shows the action is happening now, so we use the present continuous; children is plural: are playing.
why.uz: Look! harakat hozir boʻlayotganini bildiradi, shuning uchun Present Continuous kerak; children koʻplikda: are playing.
why.ru: Look! показывает, что действие происходит сейчас, — Present Continuous; children во мн. числе: are playing.

why.en: Yesterday needs the past of be, and with I it is was.
why.uz: Yesterday oʻtgan zamonni talab qiladi; I bilan be feʼli was boʻladi.
why.ru: Yesterday требует прошедшего времени; с I глагол be — was.

why.en: The past of be with they is were.
why.uz: They bilan be feʼlining oʻtgan zamon shakli — were.
why.ru: Прошедшее время be с they — were.

stem.en: Ali has a new bag. ___ bag is blue.

why.en: We show that something belongs to a person with 's: Ali's bag.
why.uz: Narsa kimga tegishli ekani 's bilan koʻrsatiladi: Ali's bag.
why.ru: Принадлежность человеку выражается через 's: Ali's bag.

stem.en: Can you help ___? I can't open the window.

why.en: After a verb (help) we use the object pronoun me.
why.uz: Feʼldan (help) keyin obyekt olmoshi me ishlatiladi.
why.ru: После глагола (help) нужно объектное местоимение me.

stem.en: Is there ___ milk in the fridge?

why.en: In questions with uncountable nouns like milk we use any.
why.uz: Milk kabi sanalmaydigan otlar bilan soʻroq gapda any ishlatiladi.
why.ru: В вопросах с неисчисляемыми существительными (milk) используется any.

stem.en: There are ___ apples on the table.

why.en: In positive sentences with plural nouns we use some.
why.uz: Darak gapda koʻplikdagi otlar bilan some ishlatiladi.
why.ru: В утвердительных предложениях с множественным числом используется some.

I get always up at seven.

why.en: Adverbs like always go before the main verb, and with I the verb has no -s.
why.uz: Always kabi ravishlar asosiy feʼl oldidan keladi, I bilan feʼlga -s qoʻshilmaydi.
why.ru: Наречия вроде always стоят перед смысловым глаголом, а с I глагол без -s.
